issues.issue: Licenses aren't the dominant part of this mixed line. The budget schedule (p7) shows 'Licenses and fees' at only 8,016. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows the line is mostly operating grants/contributions (~19-20k), charges for services 16,855, other miscellaneous revenues 11,108, franchise fees 5,092 and interest. No category is more than half, so licenses and permits is a doubtful pick. Same for detail[9], [16] and [24].

The budget schedule (p7) prints the Road Fund part as Highway allocation 39,517 + Motor vehicle fee 3,632 = 43,149. The 3,632 motor vehicle fee (motor vehicle tax) is inside state aid. It was left unsplit with a review note, which is defensible.
